text:
anya: quick follow-up from customer seed failure — operator evicted seeder on disk pressure and we ended up with partial blobs. proposing a small contract instead of a full redesign.

josh: tl;dr?

anya: resumable seed transfers: 1) chunked uploads with checksums, 2) WAL on receiver with last-acked offset, 3) temp chunk store + atomic commit, 4) extended eviction grace and tombstone lifecycle so GC doesn't nuke partials mid-retry.

maria: WAL durability levels? fsync per-chunk will kill perf.

kevin: expose durability: none|periodic-sync|sync-on-commit. default periodic-sync (1s).

josh: operator events/states? need observable transitions.

anya: states: RECEIVING -> PAUSED(reason) -> RESUMING -> COMMITTED -> ABORTED. emit seed.status events with seedID,lastOffset,pausedReason,resumeETA.

maria: config knobs in operator: evictionGraceSec, maxAttempts, maxTotalRetryWindow, tombstoneTTL, maxPartialBytesPerNode.

kevin: add circuit-breaker: if pausedRatio > 20% pause new seeds and surface console guidance.

anya: migration: one-off reconcilier job to convert existing partials into tombstones; opt-in rollout and GC TTL bump during migration.

josh: add small static `seed-checksum-verify` in airgap bundle and a resume helper CLI.

ops-bot: created infra/seed-resume-rfc #279 assigned to @anya. :white_check_mark:

anya: I'll draft RFC with state diagram, config YAML, WAL format sample, and test/chaos scenarios. pinging @josh @maria for review.

josh: include disk-usage estimate and opt-in flag for migration.

maria: will add test cases. thanks!
